# V2 actuator deterministic sweep

**Purpose:** Record the fixed-point actuator traces used to accept v2-13.
**Status:** current
**Canonical source:** this record, the executable actuator tests, and [Articulated actuators](../reference/articulated-actuators.md)
**Update when:** An actuator constant, operation order, fixture anatomy/equipment row, or trace changes.

**Fixture:** `Scenario::articulated_duel()`, name `articulated-duel-v1`, seed `1`

This is deterministic mechanics evidence, not a wall-clock benchmark. Every number
below is a signed raw 16.16 integer except angle bearings, which are raw wrapping
`u16`. The executable vectors are
`yaw_raw_vectors_match_the_frozen_contract`,
`fatigue_bills_snap_deceleration_carries_residue_and_recovers_next_idle_tick`,
`a_heavy_weapon_fatigues_its_arm_sooner`, and the ignored evidence emitter
`regenerate_actuator_evidence`. Regenerate every checked-in trace row with:

```text
cargo test -p sim --lib regenerate_actuator_evidence -- --ignored
```

## Frozen inputs

| Constant | Raw |
|---|---:|
| body yaw maximum speed | 546 |
| body yaw acceleration | 91 |
| arm bearing maximum speed | 1092 |
| arm bearing acceleration | 182 |
| arm linear maximum speed | 1638 |
| arm linear acceleration | 273 |
| minimum requested reach | 16384 |
| fatigue work divisor | 256 |
| idle fatigue recovery | 4 |

The Fighter anatomy is height `9/5`, shoulder height `7/5`, shoulder half-width
`1/4`, arm length `3/4`, and hand radius `1/10`. The Brute is height `2`, shoulder
height `3/2`, shoulder half-width `3/10`, arm length `17/20`, and hand radius
`3/25`. Sword mass/balance are `31/25` and `11/20`; Shield is `9/10` and `7/20`;
Club is `223/100` and `61/100`. The complete immutable rows remain canonical in
[Combat specs](../reference/combat-specs.md#fixture-definitions).

All unnamed command fields are `Intent::Hold`, zero movement, `Keep/Keep`, and
zero effort on axes not being swept. Other targets equal the scalar's current
value. The arm columns below are the stored state after the named tick:
`b,h,r,bs,hs,rs,fatigue,residue,hand xyz,velocity xyz`.

Two test-only Fighter-anatomy/Fighter-stat worlds carry only Sword-right or

`(0,MID,1/4)` and `(HALF,HIGH,1)`, beginning with the latter, at effort one.
